name: Royalcore

media.title: Bridgerton (2020–)
media.note: a major driver of the look's 2020s visibility

reacts_against: casual athleisure and streetwear norms, reclaiming formal, structured historical silhouettes as everyday aspiration.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Ball gowns, corsets, tiaras, castles, palaces, elaborate tea sets, gold details, pearl jewelry, handwritten letters
wiki_facts.key_colours: Gold, silver, pastel pink, powder blue, cream, rich jewel tones (royal blue, emerald green, deep red)
wiki_facts.key_values: Elegance, romance, opulence, sophistication, escapism, femininity

findings: mostly muted — about 62% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
